text: {"score":4,"justification":"Numbers match the card (15.8% vs 3.4% expected, z 1.86, risk-adjusted 5.74, 20% low-complexity share) and the exchange statements match the tool outputs (two no_response rounds, 0 usable charts, closed non-responsive).
